subject: MOVE statement
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (PB66 — the floating-point form; the fixed-point de-editing MOVE is the NIST-pinned COBOL-85 behavior). A numeric-edited SENDER de-edits only into a numeric or numeric-edited receiver: E1 → S9(5)V9(3) is -12345.600 and E1 → +9(3).9(2)E+999 is -123.45E+002 (de-edit then edit), while E1 → PIC X(12) copies the characters (an alphanumeric receiver — no de-editing). The floating-point sender de-edits to an EXACT CobolDec (the significand with its own power of ten — never a binary64), so a 36-digit significand round-trips.
